Employee.GetByDepartmentId: SELECT * FROM Employee WHERE DepartmentID=@DepartmentID AND IsDeleted = FALSE
Employee.GetByPositionId: SELECT * FROM Employee WHERE PositionID=@PositionID AND IsDeleted = FALSE
Employee.HasByDepartmentId: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Employee WHERE DepartmentID=@DepartmentID AND IsDeleted = FALSE)
Employee.HasByPositionId: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Employee WHERE PositionID=@PositionID AND IsDeleted = FALSE)
Department.GetEmployeesByCode: SELECT * FROM Employee e INNER JOIN Department d ON e.DepartmentID = d.DepartmentID WHERE d.DepartmentCode=@DepartmentCode AND e.IsDeleted = FALSE
Department.CountEmployeesByCode: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee e INNER JOIN Department d ON e.DepartmentID = d.DepartmentID WHERE d.DepartmentCode=@DepartmentCode AND e.IsDeleted = FALSE
